name: Mousehole Bookshop
source:
You're an introverted mouse who's always dreamed of working in a bookshop in the middle of nowhere so you can read books all day long. But after you finally get your dream job, the unthinkable happens: Hordes of people start to visit and spoil it all!

How long can you cope until somebody starts to recognise you - can you even make it past the probation period?

[From [url=https://painappuruproject.itch.io/mousehole-bookshop]itch.io[/url]]
